meta.title: 小作文（应用文）功能句库
meta.desc: 英语二 A 节 · 应用文（书信 / 通知），约 100 词。下面按「第几句」收集了可直接套用的功能句；{{ }} 包住的是按题目替换的槽位，词句本身不要动。
meta.note: 数据源：考研英语小作文功能句全集（用户提供）。第 1、5 步的称呼与落款原文未含，为本站补充。

steps.name: 称呼（补充，原文未含）
steps.body: Dear Sir or Madam,（不认识对方）／ Dear Bob,（认识）／ Dear Mr. Smith,。顶格写，后面用逗号。

steps.name: 第一段（2 句，约 25 词）
steps.body: 首句问候 / 自我介绍（I hope this message finds you well.…）＋ 第二句表明来意（I am writing to…）。

steps.name: 第二段（2~4 句，约 55 词）
steps.body: 先用通用首句引出（To be more specific…），再按信件类型挑 2~3 句展开。这一段的句子可以跨类型混用。

steps.name: 第三段（1~2 句，约 20 词）
steps.body: 客套收尾 / 期待回复（I would appreciate it very much if…）。

steps.name: 落款（补充，原文未含）
steps.body: Yours sincerely,（正式）／ Best wishes,（朋友）＋ 换行写题目给的名字（Li Ming）。

study: 先自己写：拿功能句对着题目写一遍（写错也没关系），写完再让 AI 按题目要求改。越少依赖 AI，你越强。

notes.slot: 第一段第二句功能句挑选
notes.text: 第一段也可以写三句，大家可以根据自己积累的功能句配合题目自行选择\~

notes.slot: 第二段第一句功能句挑选
notes.text: 小作文第二段及其灵活，考察的很多都是综合类，你可能第二段从建议类选2句，从祝贺类选1句这种。而不是死盯着某个类去只用这里面的功能句。

notes.slot: 第二段第二句功能句挑选
notes.text: 难道第二段第二句就一定写在第二句吗？也可以写在第三句第四句！大家只需要把 First、what’s more 这种前缀换一换就好了！

banks.label: 第一段 · 首句（问候 / 自我介绍）

items.en: I hope this message finds you well.
items.cn: 希望你一切安好。

items.en: I am so delighted to receive your letter.
items.cn: 非常高兴收到你的来信。

items.en: It is a great pleasure for me to write this letter to you.
items.cn: 能给你写这封信，我感到十分高兴。

items.en: I hope everything is going smoothly with your study and life.
items.cn: 希望你的学习和生活一切顺利。

items.en: I hope you are doing well these days.
items.cn: 希望你最近一切顺利。

items.en: It is really nice to hear from you again.
items.cn: 很高兴再次收到你的消息。

items.en: I hope you are enjoying good health and a pleasant life.
items.cn: 希望你身体健康，生活愉快。

items.en: I hope everything is going well on your side.
items.cn: 希望你那边一切顺利。

items.en: I feel honored to be able to write to you today.
items.cn: 今天能够给你写信，我感到很荣幸。

items.en: I am truly glad to get in touch with you.
items.cn: 能够和你取得联系，我由衷感到高兴。

items.en: We greatly appreciate all students for sparing your precious time to pay attention to this notice.
items.cn: 我们十分感谢全体同学抽出宝贵时间关注本通知。

items.en: Our sincere gratitude goes to you for your willingness to read and comply with the arrangements in this notice.
items.cn: 诚挚感谢各位愿意阅读并遵照本通知中的相关安排。

items.en: We would like to extend our thanks to every student for sparing your time amid busy schedules to pay attention to this notice.
items.cn: 谨向每位同学致谢，感谢大家百忙之中来关注本通知。

items.en: I have documented the content of the previous seminar, and the key points of the meeting minutes are listed as follows.
items.cn: 我已记录上次课程研讨会的内容，本次会议纪要的核心要点整理如下。

items.en: The content of the last graduation project team meeting has been recorded, and the detailed meeting minutes are presented below.
items.cn: 我已记录上次毕设项目组会议的内容，具体会议纪要内容如下所示。

items.en: I have compiled the content of the previous academic exchange meeting, and the structured meeting minutes are provided as follows.
items.cn: 我已整理上次学术交流会的内容，条理化的会议纪要内容详见下文。

banks.label: 第一段 · 第二句（表明来意）

items.en: I am writing to you regarding the matter of {{topic}}.
items.cn: 我写信是关于{{topic}}这一事项。

ex.en: I am writing to you regarding the matter of my sincere thanks for your warm reception during my stay in the United States and my invitation for you to visit China in due course.
ex.cn: 我写信是关于两件事：一是对你在我赴美期间热情接待的诚挚感谢，二是诚挚邀请你在方便的时候来中国访问。

items.en: I am writing to express my sincere gratitude for your help.
items.cn: 我写信是为表达我对你帮助的诚挚感谢。

items.en: I am writing to invite you to take part in {{topic}}.
items.cn: 我写信是邀请你参加{{topic}}。

ex.en: I am writing to invite you to take part in our upcoming online meeting about study and campus life at our university.
ex.cn: 我写信是邀请你参加我们即将举行的，以本校学习和校园生活为主题的线上会议。

items.en: Please allow me to extend my warmest congratulations to you.
items.cn: 请允许我向你致以最诚挚的祝贺。

items.en: I am writing on behalf of our class to discuss {{topic}}.
items.cn: 我代表我们班给你写信，讨论{{topic}}。

ex.en: I am writing on behalf of our class to discuss how we might improve students’ physical condition on campus.
ex.cn: 我代表我们班给您写信，讨论我们可以如何提升校园内学生的身体素质。

items.en: With this letter, I would like to share my views on {{topic}}.
items.cn: 借此来信，我想与你分享我对{{topic}}的看法。

ex.en: With this letter, I would like to share my views on whether you should choose the art exhibition or the robot show this Sunday.
ex.cn: 借此来信，我想和你分享我对本周日该选择参加艺术展还是机器人展的看法。

items.en: In order to further promote {{topic}}, our school has decided to issue the following notice.
items.cn: 为了进一步推进{{topic}}，学校决定发布如下通知。

ex.en: In order to further promote the summer camp for high school students that our university is going to host, our school has decided to issue the following notice.
ex.cn: 为了进一步推进我校即将举办的高中生夏令营，学校决定发布如下通知。

items.en: To ensure the smooth implementation of {{topic}}, the following arrangements are hereby announced.
items.cn: 为确保{{topic}}顺利开展，现将相关安排通知如下。

ex.en: To ensure the smooth implementation of the upcoming campus singing contest, the following arrangements are hereby announced.
ex.cn: 为确保即将举行的校园歌唱比赛顺利开展，现将相关安排通知如下。

items.en: To raise students’ awareness of {{topic}}, the school will carry out the following activities.
items.cn: 为提升学生对{{topic}}的认识，学校将开展以下活动。

ex.en: To raise students’ awareness of campus food festival and traditional Chinese food culture, the school will carry out the following activities.
ex.cn: 为提升学生对校园美食节及中国传统饮食文化的认识，学校将开展以下活动。

items.en: The purpose of this letter is to discuss {{topic}} with you in detail.
items.cn: 这封信的目的是想与你详细讨论{{topic}}。

ex.en: The purpose of this letter is to discuss our survey plan on the protection of old houses in the ancient town with you in detail.
ex.cn: 这封信的目的是想与你详细讨论我们关于古镇老宅保护调研计划的具体安排。

items.en: The primary aim of this letter is to offer some suggestions on {{topic}}.
items.cn: 本信的首要目的，是就{{topic}}提出若干建议。

ex.en: The primary aim of this letter is to offer some suggestions on improving students’ physical condition at our university.
ex.cn: 本信的首要目的是就如何提升我校学生的身体素质提出若干建议。

items.en: Through this letter, I would like to call your attention to {{topic}}.
items.cn: 借此来信，我想引起你对{{topic}}的重视。

ex.en: Through this letter, I would like to call your attention to the current problems with our university library’s services.
ex.cn: 借此来信，我想引起您对本校图书馆当前服务问题的重视。

items.en: The central purpose of this letter is to seek your advice on {{topic}}.
items.cn: 此信的核心目的，是就{{topic}}向你征求意见。

ex.en: The central purpose of this letter is to seek your advice on how I can better adapt to our shared apartment life abroad.
ex.cn: 此信的核心目的，是就我如何更好地适应今后在国外合租生活向你征求意见。

items.en: This letter is meant to convey my heartfelt thanks for your support with {{topic}}.
items.cn: 这封信旨在对你在{{topic}}方面给予的支持表达由衷感谢。

ex.en: This letter is meant to convey my heartfelt thanks for your warm reception during my visit to the United States as a member of the Sino-American cultural exchange program.
ex.cn: 这封信旨在对我作为中美文化交流项目成员赴美期间你给予的热情接待表达由衷感谢。

items.en: The purpose of this letter is to extend my sincere gratitude for your help with {{topic}}.
items.cn: 本信的目的，是为你在{{topic}}上给予的帮助致以诚挚谢意。

ex.en: The purpose of this letter is to extend my sincere gratitude for your constant help with my translation practice, which contributed a lot to my success in the recent contest.
ex.cn: 本信的目的，是为你在我翻译练习中给予的长期帮助致以诚挚谢意，这对我在近期比赛取得成功起到了重要作用。

items.en: This letter is intended to offer a sincere apology for the problems caused by {{topic}}.
items.cn: 这封信旨在就{{topic}}所带来的问题向你致以诚挚的歉意。

ex.en: This letter is intended to offer a sincere apology for the problems caused by my having to cancel my visit to you at the last minute.
ex.cn: 这封信旨在就在我最后时刻不得不取消对您的拜访所带来的种种问题向您致以诚挚的歉意。

items.en: In this letter, I would like to explain the reasons behind {{topic}} and ask for your understanding.
items.cn: 在信中，我想解释{{topic}}背后的原因，并请求你的理解。

ex.en: In this letter, I would like to explain the reasons behind my change of travel plan and ask for your understanding.
ex.cn: 在信中，我想向您说明我更改行程计划的原因，并请求您的理解。

items.en: The purpose of this letter is to invite you to take an active part in {{topic}}.
items.cn: 本信的目的，是邀请你积极参加{{topic}}。

ex.en: The purpose of this letter is to invite you to take an active part in our class charity sale for children in need.
ex.cn: 本信的目的是邀请你积极参加我们班为贫困儿童举办的义卖活动。

items.en: Through this letter, I sincerely invite you to join us in {{topic}}.
items.cn: 借此来信，我诚挚邀请你参与我们组织的{{topic}}。

ex.en: Through this letter, I sincerely invite you to join us in the upcoming campus food festival for international and Chinese students.
ex.cn: 借此来信，我诚挚邀请你参加即将举行的、面向中外学生的校园美食节。

items.en: The purpose of this letter is to recommend {{topic}} as a valuable opportunity for you.
items.cn: 本信旨在向你推荐{{topic}}这一宝贵机会。

ex.en: The purpose of this letter is to recommend the robot show on Sunday as a valuable opportunity for you to experience cutting-edge technology.
ex.cn: 本信旨在向你推荐周日的机器人展，这对你体验前沿科技是一次十分宝贵的机会。

items.en: In this letter, I would like to introduce {{topic}} to you as an excellent option.
items.cn: 在这封信中，我想向你介绍{{topic}}，把它作为一个极佳的选择推荐给你。

ex.en: In this letter, I would like to introduce the art exhibition this Sunday to you as an excellent option if you are interested in culture and creativity.
ex.cn: 在这封信中，我想向你介绍本周日的艺术展，如果你对文化与创意感兴趣，这是一个极佳的选择。

items.en: This letter serves as a formal complaint about the recent problems with {{topic}}.
items.cn: 这封信作为一份正式投诉，旨在反映近期与{{topic}}有关的问题。

ex.en: This letter serves as a formal complaint about the recent problems with the electronic dictionary I bought from your online store.
ex.cn: 这封信作为一份正式投诉，旨在反映我最近在贵网店购买的电子词典所出现的问题。

items.en: This letter is intended to extend my warm congratulations on your achievement in {{topic}}.
items.cn: 这封信旨在对你在{{topic}}方面取得的成就表示热烈祝贺。

ex.en: This letter is intended to extend my warm congratulations on your achievement in being admitted to university.
ex.cn: 这封信旨在对你考入大学这一重要成就表示热烈祝贺。

items.en: The purpose of this letter is to congratulate you sincerely on your remarkable progress in {{topic}}.
items.cn: 本信旨在对你在{{topic}}上取得的显著进步致以诚挚祝贺。

ex.en: The purpose of this letter is to congratulate you sincerely on your remarkable progress in English-Chinese translation.
ex.cn: 本信旨在对你在英汉翻译方面取得的显著进步致以诚挚祝贺。

items.en: This announcement aims to provide detailed information about {{topic}}.
items.cn: 本公告旨在提供关于{{topic}}的详细信息。

ex.en: This announcement aims to provide detailed information about our university library for the newly enrolled international students.
ex.cn: 本公告旨在向新入学的国际学生提供关于本校图书馆的详细信息。

items.en: The purpose of this notice is to remind everyone of the upcoming activities related to {{topic}}.
items.cn: 本通知旨在提醒大家即将开展的{{topic}}相关活动。

ex.en: The purpose of this notice is to remind everyone of the upcoming campus singing contest next Friday evening.
ex.cn: 本通知旨在提醒大家注意下周五晚即将举行的校园歌唱比赛。

items.en: This notice is intended to clarify the requirements for participating in {{topic}}.
items.cn: 本通知旨在说明参与{{topic}}的具体要求。

ex.en: This notice is intended to clarify the requirements for participating in Professor Smith’s research project on campus sports activities.
ex.cn: 本通知旨在说明参与史密斯教授校园体育活动研究项目的具体要求。

banks.label: 第二段 · 通用首句（引出下文）

items.en: To be more specific, the main points can be arranged as follows.
items.cn: 更具体地说，主要内容可以概括为以下几点。

items.en: In terms of concrete arrangements, the details are as follows.
items.cn: 就具体安排而言，细节如下。

items.en: With regard to the practical steps, the key information is listed below.
items.cn: 关于实际步骤，关键信息如下所示。

items.en: As for the specific arrangements, they can be outlined in the following way.
items.cn: 至于具体安排，可以概括为如下几点。

items.en: When it comes to the concrete details, they may be presented as follows.
items.cn: 说到具体细节，可以作如下说明。

items.en: As for the practical measures, my suggestions are listed as follows.
items.cn: 至于具体措施，我的建议如下。

items.en: Concerning the next steps, several suggestions can be made as follows.
items.cn: 关于下一步的做法，可以提出如下建议。

items.en: In light of the above, the following suggestions may be of some help.
items.cn: 鉴于以上情况，以下几点建议或许有所帮助。

items.en: To address this issue more effectively, the following actions are recommended.
items.cn: 为更有效地解决这一问题，建议采取以下行动。

items.en: As for the underlying reasons, they can be explained as follows.
items.cn: 至于背后的原因，可以作如下解释。

items.en: To justify my opinion, several points need to be mentioned as follows.
items.cn: 为说明我的观点，有必要提出以下几点。
